'''FK Frýdek-Místek''' is a [[association football|football]] club based in [[Frýdek-Místek]], [[Czech Republic]]. It currently plays in the [[Moravian-Silesian Football League]], which is the third tier of Czech football.<ref>{{cite web |title=FK Frýdek-Místek|url=https://www.msfl.cz/klub/mfk-frydek-mistek|publisher=Moravskoslezská fotbalová liga|access-date=2019-07-15|language=cs}}</ref>"}}
